records_captured: Move detail rows (type/power/accuracy/category/priority/pp/short_effect), scoped to move names actually reported by MunchStats tournament rosters

fields.name: move_name
fields.description: Move display name as reported in tournament roster data (Title Case, e.g. "Ice Punch")

fields.name: power
fields.description: Base power; null for status moves and variable-power moves PokéAPI reports as null

fields.name: accuracy
fields.description: Accuracy percentage (0-100); null for moves that always hit

fields.name: category
fields.description: Damage class: physical, special, or status

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Move priority bracket, 0 for normal-speed moves

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: API endpoint the record was extracted from

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: Move names are matched to PokéAPI's slug via a lowercase/hyphenate transform (pipelines/extract/pokeapi.py's _slugify); a move name with punctuation PokéAPI doesn't slug the same way would fail to resolve and simply be skipped rather than mis-mapped.
